note: RNSendSpans models the send-span ring in sdk/rocketnet_allocator.cpp (rn_span_round16, rn_span_place, rn_span_link, rn_span_unlink, rn_region_send_alloc_span, rn_region_send_free, rn_region_send_free_fragment, and the empty-ring reset in rn_region_reset): head, tail, first and last, the list in allocation order, frees in any order, wrap padding, tail == head meaning full, and the reset to 0 when empty; actions Alloc(l, d), Exhaust(l), Free(d) and Reset; invariants TypeOK, LiveSpansDisjoint, SpanInsideRing, Aligned, HeadIsOldestStart, ListInAllocationOrder, EmptyIsZero, FullAdmitsNothing, IdleAdmitsAnyMessage and LiveBetweenHeadAndTail; passing control MCRNSendSpans.cfg and reversed witnesses MCRNSendSpansBrokenFloorAtNewest.cfg (LiveSpansDisjoint) and MCRNSendSpansBrokenNoPadding.cfg (SpanInsideRing).

RNResendTiming models the resend timing of one reliable record: the delay min(rto, resend_interval) with no back-off in rn_window_ack_resend_delay (sdk/rocketnet_window_ack.h), rn_window_ack_resend and rn_window_ack_check_timeout (sdk/rocketnet_window_ack.cpp), the resend walk of rn_ordered_write (sdk/rocketnet_channel.cpp), rn_message_ordered_due and rn_message_connection_write (sdk/rocketnet_message_server.cpp), the RTO of rn_window_ack_on_ack, and the attempts rule of rocketnet_message_validate_config (sdk/rocketnet_config.cpp); actions Resend, Sample(r), Ack, Tick and Done; invariants TypeOK, ConfigAccepted, AttemptsBeforeTimeout and ResendGapBounded; passing control MCRNResendTiming.cfg and reversed witness MCRNResendTimingBrokenBackoff.cfg (AttemptsBeforeTimeout), replayed against the code by resend_timing_witness_replays (test_unit_resend_timing.cpp).

RNFilterEpochs models the keyed receiver live-generation table of STANDARD.md (The keyed filter value): Install(g) with g the next of the newest and the last generation wrapping to 1, Retire dropping the oldest when the table is full, and Check(e, k), epoch 0 refused when keyed, an epoch naming no live generation refused on a comparison with no MAC, a live one costing one MAC; invariants TypeOK, NeverKeyedAtZero, WrapSkipsZero, AtLeastTwoLiveAfterRotation, DeadEpochRefusedWithoutMac, OneMacPerLiveEpoch, LegitimateNeverRefused, OldKeyRefused and LiveGenerationsDistinct; passing control MCRNFilterEpochs.cfg and reversed witnesses MCRNFilterEpochsBrokenAcceptZero.cfg (NeverKeyedAtZero) and MCRNFilterEpochsBrokenWrapToZero.cfg (WrapSkipsZero). The code that implements it is owed: the prefilter check is unkeyed only in 1.0.

RNUringDriver models the io_uring server driver of THE DESIGN (one ring on the main thread): the send staging, where start_packet reserves the next slot by one fetch_add, finish records the bytes and abort zeroes them, and send_packets submits one SENDMSG per slot with bytes, reaps until every send it submitted has its CQE and only then resets the reservation index; the two receive banks, where a multishot RECVMSG fills provided ring buffers, each reaped receive CQE is copied into the fill bank and its buffer returned to the ring, receive_packets swaps fill and exposed, and a CQE without F_MORE re-arms the multishot; and destroy, which cancels the multishot and waits for every outstanding CQE before freeing; actions Reserve, Finish(s), Abort(s), Submit, KernelComplete(s), KernelFill(b), KernelStop, Reap(c), ReturnBuffer(b), ResetIndex, Swap, TransportReads, Destroy and Free; invariants TypeOK, NoReuseWhileKernelOwned, ExposedStable, BufferReturnedAfterCopy and FreedOnlyWhenDrained, liveness SubmittedEventuallyFree and DestroyEventuallyFrees under SpecFair; passing control MCRNUringDriver.cfg and reversed witnesses MCRNUringDriverBrokenResetBeforeReap.cfg (NoReuseWhileKernelOwned) and MCRNUringDriverBrokenOneBank.cfg (ExposedStable). The code that implements it is owed: the driver is not written yet.

FragmentsAndAcks models fragment reassembly in rocketnet_reassembly_process_fragment (sdk/rocketnet_fragment.cpp): the checks in the standard's order, placement at index x stride, the staged final, delivery inside the call and the delivered bound, one direction of a session over two Link instances with the fragmented send path of the client and server transports; actions StartPayload, StartFragmented(cnt), BurnOne, BurnFragmented(cnt), DefectiveSend, Flush, RecvAck, SendAck, RecvData, Tick and both links' environments; invariants TypeOK, SurfacedOnce, SurfacedOnlyIfOpened, BurnedNeverNamed, AckedMeansSurfaced, DeliveredExact, DeliveredOnce, CompleteDelivers and ArenaBounded, action property CountPinned, liveness OpenedSurfacesOrLaps; passing controls MCFragmentsAndAcksLiveSmall.cfg, MCFragmentsAndAcksLiveDup.cfg, MCFragmentsAndAcksPatAlternate.cfg and MCFragmentsAndAcksDefect.cfg (the committed instance a bench row), reversed witnesses MCFragmentsAndAcksWitFirstfrag.cfg (SurfacedOnlyIfOpened), MCFragmentsAndAcksWitDropfull.cfg (AckedMeansSurfaced), MCFragmentsAndAcksWitOverclaim.cfg (BurnedNeverNamed), MCFragmentsAndAcksWitNoclear.cfg (DeliveredExact), MCFragmentsAndAcksWitNosizecheck.cfg (ArenaBounded) and MCFragmentsAndAcksWitNopin.cfg (CountPinned). Findings declared as expected violations: D1 MCFragmentsAndAcksFindStale.cfg, MCFragmentsAndAcksFindStaleSmall.cfg and MCFragmentsAndAcksFindStaleAhead2.cfg (StaleOnlyIfOlder: the stale test refuses honest ids after whole-payload loss) and D2 MCFragmentsAndAcksFindBatchFull.cfg (BatchFullNeverFires: the delivered batch overflows under legitimate load).
